_description: Hand-written synthetic contract sample for tendline.seed.v1.1 (the shared work-order event ledger). It contains no real data: every asset id is a placeholder in EID-00000..EID-00099 (EID-00000 is the item-master sentinel, never an asset), work-order numbers come from the synthetic range 710001-799999, part numbers from TL900001-TL999999, people fields hold role strings only, and every text is a template sentence. Station classes, display names, item names and areas are placeholders too.

Shape follows what the WP-1 generator (wsynth_world / wsynth_emit) actually emits. The validator is wsynth_seed.py; _fixtures/selftest_fixtures.py and `python wsynth_seed.py --selftest` both delegate to wsynth_seed.check_fixture (one definition, not two).

v1.1 (2026-10-02) over v1: kind inventory.item joins the closed set (item master, emitted before the first wo.part that cites it; asset_id = the sentinel EID-00000); three generator guarantees are now contract rules (failure_started_at strictly before wo.open; scope events REACTIVE-only; production_resumed_at REACTIVE-only and strictly after the downtime start). Line and manifest schema strings are tendline.seed.v1.1 / tendline.seed.manifest.v1.1; a v1 line or manifest is refused (schema_mismatch). The file name keeps the v1 family name.
_status: Board = declarer/producer; cmms (Tendline Work) = consumer. v1 frozen at the QG-3.7 read-aloud with cmms; v1.1 = DRAFT until the cross-family review and the section 19 notice.

_mutation_ops.set: {op, seq, fields}: overwrite fields of the line whose golden seq is `seq` (golden seq runs 1..n)
_mutation_ops.swap: {op, seqs:[a,b]}: swap two lines' positions; the seq field stays positional
_mutation_ops.manifest_day_set: {op, day, fields}: overwrite one manifest.days entry
_mutation_ops.rule: each invalid case = golden + its mutation, validated in strict+complete mode; the validator's error records, reduced to {code, seq, line} and kept in report order, must equal expect_errors exactly (count, order, seq, line). A case whose expect_errors has more than one record says 'cascade' in its name. seq = the offending line's seq value; line = its 1-based position in the input; both null for manifest-level errors.
_mutation_ops.move: {op, seq, before_seq}: move the line whose original seq is `seq` to just before the line whose original seq is `before_seq` (null = to the end)
_mutation_ops.delete: {op, seqs:[a,b]}: drop the lines whose original seq is in [a, b]
_mutation_ops.split_day: {op, seq, days}: shift every line whose original seq >= `seq` by `days` days (at, wo.open failure_started_at, production_resumed_at value) and manifest exposed_until likewise
_mutation_ops.structural: move / delete / split_day address lines by their ORIGINAL seq and must come after every set / swap; after them seq is renumbered 1..n by position and manifest.days is recomputed from the events (Taipei day, n_events, sha256)
_mutation_ops.slices: each slices case = golden + its mutation, read once whole (strict+complete; must equal whole_expect_errors) and then read in the listed pieces (seqs = inclusive range of the mutated ledger; state fresh = no state, carry = the previous read's state after a JSON round trip; manifest true/false; complete true/false), each piece's error records equal to its expect_errors. chain_covers_ledger = the pieces read the whole ledger from seq 1, so their (code, seq) list must equal the whole read's. valid = no piece reports an error

invalid.case: seq not monotonic: line 22 carries seq 20, a value already used (one error; the line still occupies its slot so the next line resyncs)
event after a terminal status: a note filed on the CANCELLED work order 710003 hours later
ON_HOLD without a hold_reason (WAITING_PARTS transition with hold_reason=null)
world_id of one line differs from the manifest world => refuse to read the whole ledger
event time later than the exposure point: manifest exposed_until pulled back to 21:00 Taipei while a 21:30 event is published
first event of a work order is not wo.open: report note placed before its wo.open (same second, order swapped)
schema string of one line is the previous contract version tendline.seed.v1, not tendline.seed.v1.1 => refuse to read (a v1.1 reader does not read v1 lines)
actor outside the role closed set (role strings only, never a person)
from_status does not equal the previous status of the work order
is_downtime disagrees with the vocabulary rule (IN_PROGRESS flagged false)
hold_reason carried on a non-ON_HOLD transition
item_code outside the synthetic part-number range TL900001-TL999999
manifest n_events disagrees with the day file line count
failure_started_at later than the wo.open time
event on an asset that no asset.define declared
events of one work order on two different assets
at goes backwards relative to the previous line
malformed asset_id (not EID-ddddd / EID-ddddd-N<n>)
empty note body
manifest marks a test-only world => refuse to read unless explicitly allowed

child-EID seat whose asset_id differs from its unit (F3: EID-00005 declares unit EID-00006 as asset EID-00007); cascade: the define line is dropped, so the five events of work order 710001 on EID-00005 become unknown_asset and the manifest fleet_digest no longer matches the remaining defines
wo.part cites an item_code that no earlier inventory.item defined (in range, never defined)
inventory.item whose asset_id is a machine instead of the item-master sentinel
the same item_code defined twice by inventory.item (the second definition is the error)
failure_started_at equal to the wo.open time (must be strictly earlier)
PM work order opened with a non-empty scope (scope events are REACTIVE-only)
production_resumed_at written on a non-REACTIVE work order (710005 relabelled PM)
production_resumed_at not strictly later than the downtime start (equal to failure_started_at)
cascade: scoped parent work order 710004 relabelled PM - its wo.open scope, its wo.scope and its production_resumed_at are each REACTIVE-only
inventory.item later than the wo.part that cites it, same day file (item TL900018 moved after its 02:20 part; definitions must precede references)

cascade: complete ledger without its baseline master (every asset.define and inventory.item removed; the ledger is cut to the 12 lines old seq 11-22) - complete=True forces reference checks, so every event is unknown_asset and the part is unknown_item

tolerated.case: unknown kind is skipped and counted, never an exception (consumer is lenient); strict mode reports closed_set
reserved kind (pm.schedule, not part of v1) with none of its fields: consumer mode skips and counts it; strict mode rejects it with reserved_kind
additive unknown field on an event is dropped by normalize (not an error outside strict mode)

slices.case: valid: master in read 1 (seq 1-10, no manifest), the rest in read 2 with the carried state (complete) - state.master_complete carries the baseline

valid: stateless slice that starts after an omitted earlier item (TL900003, seq 9) and contains a later one (TL900018) - the part cites the omitted TL900003; a slice without a from-start chain does not judge references
carried state enforces references: read 2 (with the state from a seq-1 read) cites TL900019, never defined
two day files: inventory.item TL900018 defined in day 2 (2026-07-04) after the day-1 wo.part that cites it - read day by day with the carried state
two day files: item TL900018 defined in day 1 and again in day 2 (the day-2 definition is item_redefined) - read day by day with the carried state

_note: asset.schedule_state.in_production is not in the golden (a return-to-plan needs a later day); the generator emits it.
wo.field downtime_estimated / scheduled_date / assigned_vendor / confirmed_reason_code are declared but not emitted in phase 1.

test_vectors A and B are byte-form / hash vectors (s5.7) and are deliberately left byte-identical to v1: their lines still carry the string tendline.seed.v1, which check_vector does not read (the vectors pin canonical bytes, day sha256, fleet_digest and world_id, none of which v1.1 changed).

v1.1 cross-family review fix round (2026-10-02): reference checks (unknown_asset / unknown_item) are judged only when the master baseline is complete - a complete=True read, or a read chain that started at seq 1 (state.master_complete). Two invalid cases (item master later than its same-day wo.part; cascade complete ledger with no baseline master) and the slices section (piecewise / two-day-file reads with fresh or carried state) cover ordering and cross-file behaviour; the structural mutation ops move / delete / split_day renumber seq and recompute manifest.days.
